retired._note: PRE-ACTIVATION per-set Bowman index #1 (built 2026-09-07 by bcb26-index-prebuild, charter 4.8). Universe rows use {id, number, player, team, tab, first?, board?} (the Pokémon tickers use {num, name, rarity}; /indices reads only .length). basket rows, once STEP 3.6 writes them: {id, number, player, tab, price, basis:'ask (eBay verified, engine)'|'sold (SCP)', asOf, units?, prevPrice?, prevAsOf?}. AUTOS 15% single-card cap = fractional units at (re)constitution, logged in divisorLog. Activation: first re-mark where verified asks cover ≥60% of chase-basket value → divisor = basketValue/100, inception = that date, history[0] = {level 100.00}, status 'live', basis stays 'ask' (labeled on-page) until ≥60% SCP sold coverage → restate to 'sold' via a logged divisor adjustment (level identical before/after). Never blend asks and solds in one basket. Re-marks: every board-touching run (Mon/Tue/Fri) through street+21d, then weekly.

retired.activationRule: COUNT basis (restated 2026-09-11 by the CoS - on an ask basis an unverified card has no value, so a value-share gate was unmeasurable): activates on the first re-mark where >=60% of chase-basket CARDS (>=6 of 9 in v1) carry an engine-verified ask (>=4 verified listings); divisor = basket value / 100, inception = that date, level 100.00. Restates to hammer basis via a logged divisor adjustment at >=60% SCP sold coverage.
retired.chaseBasketNote: CHASE BASKET v1 (CoS ruling 2026-09-11, charter 4.8). The universe is every checklist card; the CHASE BASKET is the bounded subset the engine actually feeds and the activation gate is measured on. v1 = the cards the site itself already names as the chase on /bowman-chrome-baseball-2026: Ethan Holliday BCP-209 (board-flagged base) + the four 2026 IFA headliners' 1st Bowman Chrome Prospect Autos (Luis Hernandez CPA-LH, Wandy Asigen CPA-WA, Francisco Renteria CPA-FR, Angeibel Gomez CPA-AG) and their 1st Bowman base cards (BCP-200/152/163/194). Grows only via the Tuesday STEP 0 release synthesis, each addition a logged divisor adjustment. Feeds carry boardHide:true (Signal Board stays 2026 paper-class).
